motion.replayGuarantee: Same implementation/runtime/options/seed and ordered integer tick log gives identical state and logical cells regardless of render grouping. No cross-font/cross-engine pixels claim.

interaction.pointer: CSS rect normalized to [-1,1], finite coordinates clamp, zero-size returns null, guide coalesces; tap guides rather than implicit hit-target pounce.
interaction.keyboard: Native Guide select/buttons plus Pounce, Pause, Reset; no global key interception.
interaction.touch: Native controls; no hover dependence or touch scrolling suppression.
interaction.precedence: Motion policy wins. Ordered guide/leave inputs; at most one pounce per tick. Busy/cooldown triggers ignored, never queued; reduced-motion explicit action selects one static pose.

accessibility.description: A side-profile fox with pointed ears, long muzzle, four narrow legs and a bushy tail. It stalks, sniffs and makes a deliberate short pounce.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Static poster; deliberate guide/pounce chooses a single static pose. No automatic tick or pointer-driven playback.
accessibility.pause: User pause persists across reset/configuration. Hidden, offscreen, zero-size and reduced-motion causes compose.
accessibility.liveRegion: User action summaries only; no per-frame/glyph announcements.

provenance.source: Original fox polygons, articulated chains and simulation authored in species/fox; user supplied anatomical anchors.
